results.remarks: Morning light moves easily through this home. Set along a quiet, tree-lined stretch of Arlington Avenue, this cheery two-bedroom Edwardian unfolds with an immediate sense of calm and openness. Positioned on the second floor of a classic four-unit building, the home’s eastern exposure welcomes soft morning light that gently fills the living spaces as the day begins. The layout has been thoughtfully reimagined into an open-concept design, where the kitchen becomes the natural center of daily life. Anchored by stone counters, stainless steel appliances, and clean modern lines, it’s a space suited for both quiet mornings and easy evenings with friends, spilling out to an inviting balcony just off the kitchen. New engineered wood floors run underfoot, while high ceilings and preserved period woodwork add depth and character, subtle reminders of the home’s Edwardian roots. Every detail supports comfort and ease: dual-pane windows, in-unit laundry, and a seamless flow that makes the home feel larger than its footprint, with virtually no wasted space. And then there is the location. Drawing energy from Temescal's restaurants, shops, and neighborhood rhythm, and with easy access to BART and freeways, the city feels close but never overwhelming. It’s a setting where convenience and character meet, and daily life moves with a bit more ease. A home that lives simply, and lingers quietly.

results.remarks: They don’t build them like this anymore. This sun-filled, quietly elegant condo—with exclusive-use outdoor space—is set on a beautiful tree-lined block at the crossroads of Rockridge and Elmwood.  Surrounded by grand homes, 6426 Benvenue Ave. #1 reminds you what character actually looks like. Walls of windows fill the living room with natural light, creating a space that feels warm and alive throughout the day. French doors connect the living room and bedroom, allowing the entire home to flow beautifully. An original fireplace, hardwood floors and built-ins add the kind of period detail that gives an older home its soul.  The eat-in kitchen is the kind of place where a slow morning makes sense. Hex tile floors, stainless appliances and a comfortable dining area make it both charming and practical. Community laundry is on site, with a convenient location for a future in-unit washer and dryer, if desired.  But the outdoor space changes the equation entirely. An exclusive-use patio tucked beneath mature redwoods creates a surprisingly peaceful retreat—a place for morning coffee, dinner with friends or simply a quiet afternoon outside. It’s the kind of privacy and calm that’s hard to find just a few blocks from Rockridge BART.  And that’s the magic of this location: you’re in the middle of everything and somehow removed from all of it. Walk to Boichik Bagels, Cole Coffee, Market Hall and the shops, restaurants and cafés of both Rockridge and Elmwood. A dedicated parking space is included, but in a location like this, a car is truly optional.

results.remarks: Water views, soaring ceilings, and walls of natural light set the tone for this beautifully updated 3 bedroom, 2 bath end-unit condo along the peaceful Oakland-Alameda Estuary. Large bay windows frame views of the waterway, creating a striking backdrop for the open, airy living spaces. Fresh paint, new carpeting, and newly refinished hardwood floors add to the home’s bright, move-in-ready feel.  The updated kitchen features quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, a gas range, abundant cabinetry, and bar-style seating, while the spacious dining area flows seamlessly into the open living room. Step outside to the private balcony and enjoy the peaceful waterfront setting. The main level features two bright and spacious bedrooms with ceiling fans and generous closets, along with a full bathroom. A large dedicated laundry room offers built-in cabinetry, a folding counter, washer and dryer. Upstairs, the primary suite occupies its own private level, featuring a spacious bedroom, a loft area overlooking the living room and waterway, and a generous en-suite bathroom with a soaking tub, separate shower, dual vanity, and walk-in closet. Additional highlights include an integrated intercom and alarm system, an upgraded water heater, and tandem parking with built-in storage cabinets. Just across the Park Street Bridge, enjoy easy access to Alameda’s vibrant Park Street district with its restaurants, shops, and amenities. The Bay Trail is right outside your front door, while BART, the Alameda and Jack London Square ferry terminals, and Oakland International Airport are all just a short drive away, providing convenient access throughout the Bay Area and beyond.

results.remarks: Beautifully updated and exceptionally spacious 1-bedroom, 1-bath condo filled with natural light and stylish contemporary details. Elegant laminate flooring flow throughout the home, creating a warm and inviting feel. The sunny dining room is a standout, featuring chic wallpaper and a designer light fixture.  The updated kitchen offers crisp white cabinetry, quartz countertops, and newer appliances. A generously sized living room provides plenty of space to relax, with ample room to create a comfortable study or work-from-home area. Sliding glass doors open to a quiet, private balcony overlooking mature trees, with just the right amount of space for breakfast or morning coffee for two.  The updated bathroom features contemporary tile, a Toto toilet, and a shower over the bathtub. The spacious bedroom includes a huge walk-in closet, while two additional large walk-in closets in the hallway plus a separate linen closet provide exceptional storage.  Set within a smaller, quiet 19-unit HOA with lower HOA fees, the home also offers one assigned parking space in the garage, a 45" x 45" x 45" storage cubby, a building elevator, and a shared laundry facility on the first level.  Enjoy an incredible location near vibrant Piedmont Avenue—a Walker’s Paradise with a Walk Score of 91. Neighborhood favorites include Peet’s Coffee, La Farine Bakery, Timeless Coffee, Fentons Creamery, Piedmont Grocery, Piedmont Theatre, plus an eclectic collection of restaurants, cafés, boutiques, and specialty shops. Nearby parks and green spaces include the beautiful Morcom Rose Garden, with Lake Merritt also within easy reach. Convenient access to AC Transit and MacArthur BART makes getting around Oakland and the Bay Area easy, while quick access to I-580 and Highway 24 adds even more convenience. A wonderful combination of generous living space, abundant storage, private outdoor space, walkability, shopping, dining, recreation, and transportation.

results.remarks: Push open the big, beautiful gates and the city falls away. What's waiting is a secret garden — the romantic, storybook entry that makes you feel like you've slipped into an English cottage, right in the heart of Temescal.  This home was taken down to the studs and rebuilt. Behind the original double-hung windows and hardwood floors: all-new plumbing, new electrical, and a forced-air furnace. Vintage soul, none of the 3-a.m. surprises.  At 901 square feet, your light-filled upstairs home lives large. New kitchen with stone counters and room to actually cook. Fresh bathroom. Original built-in cabinetry in the formal dining room. A bedroom with a fireplace, built-ins, and a walk-in closet — plus a separate den for the home office or the reading nook. In-unit laundry, so you never hunt for quarters again.  Storage? You win. A private storage locker over 150 sqft with its own entrance — the bikes, the holiday bins, the wine, the someday projects, all of it.   Outside, the common gardens are yours: fire up the grill, gather at the picnic area, wind the evening down by the fire pit. And in a neighborhood this walkable, Temescal's best restaurants and shops are two blocks away.  Charm you can't fake, bones you can count on, in a neighborhood everyone's trying to get into.  Fully remodeled to the studs: new plumbing, electrical, and forced-air heating. New kitchen with stone counters, new bathroom, hardwood floors throughout, original double-hung windows, in-unit laundry, wood-burning fireplace, original built-in cabinetry, walk-in closet, and a flexible den. Private storage locker 150 sqft with separate entrance. Common gardens with grill, picnic area, and fire pit. Walkable Temescal, Oakland location — 2 blocks to restaurants and shopping. 1 bed / 1 bath / 901 sq ft.

Elevated ceilings, hardwood floors, and floor-to-ceiling windows create a bright, modern interior framed by Oakland’s skyline. The Ellington is a full-service, professionally attended high-rise with a 24-hour lobby, concierge services, controlled elevator access, a 50-foot heated pool and spa, fitness center, and designer clubroom with a catering kitchen.  Outside your door, Jack London Square offers waterfront paths, restaurants, cafés, entertainment, and easy access to Alameda Landing by car or water taxi. results.remarks: Tucked toward the back of Oakland’s Laurel District, this bright two-story townhouse-style condo gives you the best kind of balance: close to the neighborhood, but tucked away enough to feel like you have your own little retreat. With 2 spacious bedrooms, 1.5 bathrooms, and a functional layout that feels more like a home than a typical condo, this one keeps things comfortable, practical, and easy to love.  One of the biggest highlights is the private expanded redwood deck unique to this home within the community. Framed by taller fencing for added privacy, it gives you the kind of outdoor space that is hard to find in a condo or smaller apartment. There is room to lounge, dine, garden, or create a cozy outdoor setup without feeling like you are right on top of everything else. It is the kind of extra space that quietly makes everyday living feel better.  Inside, the main level offers a cozy living room with a fireplace, great natural light, a separate dining area, a space-efficient kitchen, and a convenient half bathroom downstairs, perfect for guests when hosting without sending everyone upstairs into your personal living space. Upstairs, both oversized bedrooms feature generous closets with floor-to-ceiling mirrored doors, adding storage, openness, and a clean modern feel. And for the everyday wins, this home comes with IN-UNIT LAUNDRY, one dedicated carport parking space, plus ample street parking for added convenience.  Located just blocks from local coffee shops, restaurants, shopping, and everyday essentials, this Laurel District location keeps you close to the energy of the neighborhood while still giving you a peaceful place to come home to. With quick access to freeways and public transportation, this home delivers the Bay Area balance everyone is looking for: convenience, comfort, privacy, and a little outdoor space you will actually use.

Thoughtfully designed for comfortable, low-maintenance living, this inviting home features an open and functional floor plan filled with abundant natural light.  The updated kitchen flows seamlessly into the living and dining areas, creating an ideal space for everyday living and entertaining. Luxury vinyl plank flooring extends throughout the home, while the cozy wood-burning fireplace adds warmth and character to the main living space. Additional upgrades include an in-unit laundry area with newer washer and dryer, newer refrigerator, and a truly unique retreat—a private sauna located in the spacious primary bedroom.  The property also offers a dedicated parking space and a generously sized private storage unit, providing convenience and extra room for your belongings.  Enjoy being just moments from some of Oakland's favorite local destinations, including Farmer Joe's, Sequoia Diner, neighborhood cafés, restaurants, fitness studios, parks, and the beloved Laurel Street Fair. Commuters will appreciate the easy access to Highways 580, 13, and 24, along with nearby public transit options connecting you throughout the Bay Area.  Whether you're a first-time homebuyer, investor, or professional seeking a stylish and conveniently located home, this property offers an exceptional opportunity. Pet-friendly community with **LOW HOA dues** and **no rental restrictions**, a rare combination of flexibility, value, and lifestyle in one of Oakland's most desirable neighborhoods.

results.remarks: Fresh Price! Introducing an Uptown flat in a boutique 6-unit Victorian building. This condo feels like a single-family home with a generous living area and proper dining room both with gleaming hardwood floors. Two generous sized bedrooms boast large walk-in closets and fresh carpet. Upper corner location with lots of energy efficient windows bring in natural light. A private balcony off the primary bedroom provides a spot to enjoy the outdoors in the sun or unfurl the retractable awning for some shade. An oversized attic for storage and endless possibilities. Walk score of 97. This is the downtown jewel you have been looking for!

results.remarks: More than a typical 1-bedroom, this Jack London Square condominium offers the flexibility of a home office/guest room without the price tag of a 2-bedroom. Designed by acclaimed local architect David Baker and built in 2006, the home features a versatile alcove — originally designed as a den — transformed with extensive custom built-ins, including a pull-down full-size Murphy bed with a device outlet, built-in desk, printer cabinet, filing drawers, coat closet, broom closet, shoe closet, and abundant storage cabinets. Use it as a home office, guest space, extra storage, or all three — it has versatility beyond a traditional one-bedroom floor plan. The bright, inviting main living space offers soaring ceilings, warm wood floors, and dramatic floor-to-ceiling windows that fill the home with natural light, while a private balcony adds valuable outdoor livable space. Practical extras include an in-unit laundry closet, one deeded parking space in the secured garage, and a dedicated storage compartment, all within a secure-entry building offering peace of mind in the heart of the city. This location holds broad appeal from those who are drawn equally by the ease of car-free living and the vibrant lifestyle right outside the door. The address sits near Amtrak's Jack London Square station, with BART, AC Transit local and Transbay bus lines, the San Francisco Bay Ferry, and major freeways all close at hand. results.remarks: What happens when a design obsessive spends 14 years turning a live/work loft into something quietly extraordinary? This 1bd/1ba live/work loft at 1018 E 4th Street, Unit 204 is 1,164 sq ft* of considered, layered space, the kind that reveals itself slowly, detail by detail. Hardwood floors, professionally sanded and finished with a custom warm tint, run throughout. Light moves freely, anchored by the piece de resistance: custom Crittall Windows UK "portes-fenêtres style atelier" True Divided Light doors and windows, imported from the UK, that define the bedroom suite while keeping the space open and luminous. The kitchen is a full renovation. Caesarstone countertops, custom cabinetry, a full suite of appliances including a gas cooktop, convection speed oven, and dishwasher, plus Vipp wall shelves and pendant lighting above the dining area, which makes every evening feel intentional. The bathroom followed suit: walk-in shower, floating vanity, Porcelanosa tile, designer lighting by Vipp and Muuto, and a sliding door connecting the bath to the bedroom for seamless flow. A discreet utility closet houses the stacked washer/dryer without giving up an inch of livability. The boiler has recently been upgraded, and the bathroom utility closet reconfigured for additional storage. The bedroom suite itself is a study in thoughtful design, a custom loft frame, a walk-in closet build-out, and those Crittall doors that make the whole thing feel more Parisian atelier than Oakland condo. This is a live/work unit in the truest sense: a calm, design-forward environment to create, collaborate, and come home to. Right in the mix; Jack London Square adjacent, with downtown Oakland, the waterfront, and transit all close at hand. Unit 204 at 1018 E 4th Street isn't just move-in ready. It's move-in and exhale.
